name: Arrearage Management Plan (AMP)
description: Save up to $8,000 on overdue utility bills for CARE and FERA customers; must owe at least $500 ($250 gas-only) and be more than 90 days past due
fullDescription: PG&E's Arrearage Management Plan helps CARE-enrolled customers reduce their past-due utility debt by forgiving up to $8,000 over 12 months when they make consistent on-time payments.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to $8,000 in debt forgiveness
- Part of your past-due balance forgiven each month you pay on time
- Full forgiveness after 12 on-time monthly payments
- You can miss up to two non-consecutive payments and stay enrolled
- Amounts already forgiven stay forgiven even if you are removed
- Works alongside CARE or FERA discount
howToGetIt:
1. Must be enrolled in PG&E CARE or FERA program
2. Must owe at least $500 (or $250 for gas-only accounts)
3. Balance must be more than 90 days past due
4. Must be a PG&E customer for at least 6 months with at least one on-time payment
5. Contact PG&E or apply online to enroll
6. Make on-time monthly payments for 12 months; if you leave the program, wait 12 months to reapply
keywords: AMP, arrearage, debt forgiveness, PG&E, past due, overdue, utility bill, CARE, payment plan, $8000
